description: Colour reference inputs for CIEDE2000: raw Lab pairs, hex colors converted through sRGB -> XYZ -> Lab, and minimum-distance palette aggregation with threshold 10.

lab_pairs.name: near_threshold_pair
lab_pairs.note: Chosen so Delta-E is close to the 10.0 distinguishability threshold.

lab_pairs.name: sharma_case1
lab_pairs.note: Classic Sharma et al. CIEDE2000 test vector; expected ~2.0425.

lab_pairs.name: sharma_case_large_hue
lab_pairs.note: Large hue difference between two low-chroma colors (a* vs b* swap).

lab_pairs.name: clearly_distinct
lab_pairs.note: Black vs white in LAB -> very large Delta-E.

hex_pairs.name: hex_similar_blues
hex_pairs.note: Two similar blues; likely below distinguishability threshold.

hex_pairs.name: hex_distinct
hex_pairs.note: Blue vs orange (tableau categorical); clearly distinguishable.

palettes.name: distinguishable_categorical
palettes.note: Tableau-like categorical colors; all pairwise distances should exceed 10.0 -> distinguishability score 1.0.

palettes.name: too_similar
palettes.note: Near-duplicate blues; at least one pair below threshold -> score < 1.0.
